result: The authors claim that a new form of green fluorescent protein enables faster super-resolution imaging of living cells at low radiation doses, demonstrating the potential of nanoscopy at low light intensities.
status_reasoning: All three claims (C1, C2, C3) are stated as conclusions in the abstract and title but lack any supporting experimental data, methodological details, statistical analysis, or citations in the provided manuscript excerpt. Without access to the methods, results, figures, or references sections, it is impossible to evaluate whether the claims about imaging speed, radiation dose reduction, or the properties of the new fluorescent protein variant are substantiated by rigorous experimental evidence.
